I need to identify whether the webhook delivery workers consume from NATS or RabbitMQ and locate where the queue is declared.

Checking `internal/webhook/webhook.go` to confirm whether webhook delivery uses a message broker.

The webhook delivery workers consume from an in-process buffered Go channel. They run as four goroutines initialized in `init()`. There is no NATS or RabbitMQ broker involved.

Checking PostAsync callers and go.mod for any broker dependencies.
Searching for PostAsync calls in the memo service to identify the message broker and queue declaration.

The repository does not use NATS or RabbitMQ.

Webhook delivery workers consume from an in-process Go channel. Four workers consume from `asyncPostQueue`, declared as `make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` and initialized with worker goroutines.
